env.description: POC mode: paste a Deepgram API key here (Webfuse Studio → Space → Extensions → settings). It is sent from each participant's browser straight to api.deepgram.com. For production, leave this empty and use TOKEN_URL with a Member-permission key that can mint short-lived grants.

Optional HTTPS endpoint returning {token, mode}: a short-lived Deepgram credential minted via POST /v1/auth/grant (see server.js in the repo for a self-hostable implementation). Takes precedence over nothing — DEEPGRAM_API_KEY is checked first. The endpoint must send Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *.
